SIMULATOR.TITLE: Simulated customer
SIMULATOR.DESCRIPTION: Test WhatsApp calls without a number: this page acts as the customer's phone. It uses the real path (Meta webhook and services) and real audio with the agent's tab.
SIMULATOR.DISABLED: The simulated Meta is off. To use it, the server must have WHATSAPP_CALLS_SIMULATOR=true (development only).
SIMULATOR.NO_INBOXES: No inboxes with calls enabled in this account. Enable the whatsapp_calls flag and calls on a WhatsApp Cloud inbox.
SIMULATOR.NAME: Customer name
SIMULATOR.PERMISSION_TITLE: The business asks permission to call you:

LOG.CALLING: You called the business; it is ringing
LOG.PERMISSION_ASKED: The business asked permission to call you

WIDGET.TITLE: WhatsApp call
WIDGET.CALL_BUTTON_HINT: Call the customer on WhatsApp from the browser
WIDGET.ALREADY_TAKEN: Another agent already answered the call.
WIDGET.ANSWER_ERROR: Could not answer. Check the browser has permission to use the microphone.
WIDGET.BUSY: You already have a call in progress.
WIDGET.PERMISSION_REQUESTED: The customer does not allow calls yet: the request was sent on WhatsApp. We'll let you know when they accept.
WIDGET.PERMISSION_LIMIT: The customer has not allowed calls and was asked recently (WhatsApp limits requests). You can ask again on {date}.
WIDGET.PERMISSION_GRANTED: {name} allowed you to call them on WhatsApp. You can call now.

SETTINGS.FEATURE_DISABLED: WhatsApp calls are not enabled for this account. Ask the super admin to enable the «whatsapp_calls» flag.
SETTINGS.SIMULATOR_ON: You are using the simulated Meta: enabling changes nothing in Meta and calls are tested with the simulated customer.
SETTINGS.ENABLE_HINT: Answer and make WhatsApp calls from the browser. Only works with the official API (Cloud API) and a number Meta allows for calls.
SETTINGS.MANUAL_WEBHOOK: This inbox is set up manually: in your Meta App dashboard (WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhooks) tick the «calls» field, or calls won't arrive.
SETTINGS.DIRECTION_HINT: With «outbound only», your customers won't see the call button in WhatsApp.
SETTINGS.RING_HINT: All of them ring at once and the first to answer takes it.

RING.CASCADE: The assignee if online; otherwise online inbox agents; if nobody, everyone

SETTINGS.PERMISSION_HINT: WhatsApp requires the customer's permission before you call. This text is sent with an «Allow calls» button (at most once a day and twice a week).
